reason: The command-script and stdio protocols accept dynamic JSON payloads by design. Their CLI entry points are untyped; callers that need compile-time engine types must use the language APIs instead.

The optional shared CLI accepts dynamic JSON and forwards all three engines to the JavaScript command server. Native library launches remain the default; the CLI needs Node.js and the selected JavaScript engine package.

Caller-owned interruption and browser hand-off (issue #174) are implemented in JavaScript, where Command Stream forwards SIGINT to every started child and the engines install their own SIGINT handlers. The Python and Rust ports are tracked as follow-up work; a JavaScript-written hand-off is plain JSON with a CDP endpoint and target id, so those languages can already attach with connect_browser.
